answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in horizon, expire in haven, and pulse lists each expiry. Anyone running 58 aliases as a result needs 84 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1403 identities would post 4699 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
